1. Dataset and Task Description

Biomedical voice measurements from 42 people with early-stage Parkinson's disease recruited to a six-month trial of a telemonitoring device.

3. Mathematical Methodology

Adds an \(\ell_1\) penalty on standardized slopes (leaving \(\beta_0\) unpenalized) to perform continuous shrinkage and automatic variable selection via coordinate-wise soft-thresholding.

$$\min_{\beta_0 \in \mathbb{R},\, \boldsymbol{\beta} \in \mathbb{R}^p} \frac{1}{2n}\|\mathbf{y} - \beta_0\mathbf{1} - \tilde{\mathbf{X}}\boldsymbol{\beta}\|_2^2 + \alpha\|\boldsymbol{\beta}\|_1, \qquad \hat{\beta}_j = \mathcal{S}\!\left(\frac{1}{n}\tilde{\mathbf{x}}_j^\top \mathbf{r}^{(-j)}, \alpha\right) \quad \left(\lambda \equiv \alpha \ge 0,\ \frac{1}{n}\|\tilde{\mathbf{x}}_j\|_2^2 = 1\right)$$

Implementation Note: min_{beta0, beta} (1 / (2*n)) * ||y - beta0 - X*beta||_2^2 + alpha * ||beta||_1 (intercept beta0 unpenalized)
CV-Selected Hyperparameter: \(\alpha^* = 1.2694\) (\(\lambda \equiv \alpha\)) over 60 grid points in \([0.0004426, 4.426]\).

7. Limitations and Conclusions

Facts & Interpretations

  • [Computed Fact] Held-out test performance (\(n_{\mathrm{test}} = 1235\)): \(R^2 = -0.2699\), \(\mathrm{RMSE} = 10.26\) UPDRS points (Train \(R^2 = 0.1571\), Train \(\mathrm{RMSE} = 10.12\) UPDRS points).
  • [Computed Fact] Largest standardized coefficients by magnitude: age (+3.112), PPE (+0.4155), sex (+0).
  • [Computed Fact] GroupKFold(5, group=subject#) selected \(\alpha^* = 1.269\) (CV RMSE = 10.35 UPDRS points, CV \(R^2 = -0.0953\)), converging in 4 coordinate-descent iterations.
  • [Interpretation] Soft-thresholding retained \(|A(\alpha^*)| = 2\) of \(p = 19\) predictors and eliminated 17 (89.5% sparse), reducing the \(\ell_1\) norm from 1929 (OLS) to 3.528 (ratio = 0.0018).
  • [Computed Fact] Eliminated predictors include sex, test_time, Jitter(%), Jitter(Abs), Jitter:RAP (max \(|r|\) with a retained predictor = 0.769).

Assumptions & Limitations

  • [Selection Instability Under Collinearity] 4 predictor(s) varied in selection across CV folds (e.g., test_time (0.40), sex (0.20), HNR (0.20), DFA (0.20)), because \(\ell_1\) KKT pinning selects one representative among correlated features.
  • [Solver Convergence] Coordinate descent emitted warning(s) (final converged = True, CV warnings = 8).
  • [Group Generalization] Evaluation tests unseen 'subject#' clusters without subject-specific random intercepts.
  • [Generalization Gap] Test \(R^2\) (-0.2699) drops from Train \(R^2\) (0.1571), indicating distribution shift or limited linear generalization.
  • [Linearity Assumption] Linear models assume additive linear relationships between standardized predictors and conditional target expectation.
